plan.name: daily_fx_value_forward_v1
notes: Book: plan v2's H1_XS_REAL_VALUE_5Y exactly (signal, sizing, invariants, costs), rejected at its development gate (deflated Sharpe 0.77); tracked forward because only data that did not exist when it was frozen can test it cleanly.

Prices: the operator's MT5 D1 exports of the nine USD pairs; the last bar of every file is dropped; the panel runs from exactly 2018-01-02 (every pair must reach it) to the last day every pair has, and a pair more than one business day behind refuses the run.
Forward days: from 2026-10-26, after this plan was frozen; earlier days only build the book's state.

Inflation: the pinned World Bank file (datasets/cpi 3750e450) up to 2024; each later year from a World Bank download, taken the first time all ten series have it and never revised afterwards. Year Y is used from 1 July of Y+1; a rebalance whose inputs are missing stops the record the day before it.
Primary returns: the study's definition (spot, study costs, 75 bps/yr mark-up on gross exposure). Kept alongside: the mark-up replaced by the broker's captured swap terms (POINTS mode only).

Ledger: each checkpoint seals its days' returns, every close from 2018-01-02 not yet sealed, its decisions, fixed inflation years and input hashes; a later run must recompute sealed returns within 1e-10, read sealed closes within a relative 1e-12 and recompute decisions exactly, or it refuses. Sealed broker-swap values are never recomputed; a final status closes the record.

Rule: annual looks for ten years; CONFIRMED when the Newey-West t of the primary daily returns reaches the O'Brien-Fleming boundary (5.695, 4.027, 3.288, 2.848, 2.547, 2.325, 2.153, 2.014, 1.898, 1.801; one-sided alpha 0.05) and the broker-swap series covers 80% of the days with a positive total; ABANDONED at a 12% drawdown or a t <= -1 from the second look; ENDED after ten looks.

Power, simulated before any forward day (an upper bound): P(CONFIRMED within 10 years) is about 0.05 with no edge, 0.23 at a true net Sharpe of 0.3, 0.33 at 0.4, 0.45 at 0.5, 0.57 at 0.6 and 0.79 at 0.8; within 5 years 0.03-0.23.
The tracker runs from a git worktree pinned at the freeze commit; the plan binds the engine, the tracker, its runner and the swap conversion code.
No outcome authorises execution; a confirmation only allows a decision record about live trading, which AGENTS.md keeps out of scope.
